label: TP
reason: User input extracted from query string flows through doSomething with an ineffective sanitization (replacing only the last character) and is directly printed to the HTTP response via getWriter().println() without HTML encoding, allowing XSS payloads to render.

evidence.note: User input extracted and decoded from query string
Weak sanitization replaces only last character, leaving rest of payload intact
Directly prints sanitized user input to response without encoding
